votes.motion: Issue a standard order of conditions for the Mike Nault Notice of Intent (single family home in buffer zone, 141 Hemlock Road).

votes.motion: Continue the Hickory Hills Association Notice of Intent hearing to 10/17.
votes.quote: bp moved to continue to 10/17. cc seconded and the commission approved the motion by a roll call vote.

votes.motion: Issue a positive determination for the Barbara and Michael Battle request for determination (grading within buffer zone and riverfront, 168 West Street).
votes.quote: cl moved for a positive determination. bp seconded and the commission approved by unanimous roll

votes.motion: Continue the Mike Gormley Notice of Intent hearing (shoreline restoration, 611 Reservoir Road).
votes.quote: cl moved for a continuation.cc seconded and the commission approved the motion by a roll call vote.

votes.motion: Issue a positive determination for the Nanci Bell request for determination (retaining wall replacement, 51 Fire Road 19).
votes.quote: cl moved to issue a positive determination. bp seconded and the commission voted unanimously by roll call vote

votes.motion: Nominate Richard Bursch as chair and Todd Dwyer as vice chair for continued service.
votes.quote: bp nominated rb for continued char and td for continued vice chair. the motion was seconded by cl and unanimously approved by the commission

votes.motion: Nominate Carl Luck as commission clerk for continued service.
votes.quote: bp nominated cl for continued commission clerk. cc seconded and the commission unanimously approved.

votes.motion: Not harvest Robbs Hill for a year, hold a workshop day on the issue, and have MM complete an RDA for the small town forest parking area and remaining cleanups.
votes.quote: this was by a motion of td and a se cond by bp with a unanimous vote by roll call vote.

votes.motion: Grant Bob Pease's request to sponsor mountain bike rides jointly with the New England mountain bike association.
votes.quote: bp narrated his request which was granted by a motion of kj and a second by rb with unanimous roll call vote.

votes.motion: Approve the Certificate of Compliance for lots 7 and 4 of 380 Sunset Lane.
votes.quote: the commission approved the coc for lot 7 and 4 of 380 sunset by a motion of cl and a second by bp with a unanimous roll call vote.

votes.motion: Extend the Lake Shirley Order of Conditions for 6 months, to 4/17/19.
votes.quote: the commission voted to extend for 6 months to 4/17/19 by a motion of bp and a second by td
